notes.title: Week 1 Update Newsletter - New Levels + Russian Language Support
notes.content:
[h1]4 New Levels![/h1]

[h2]Basic[/h2]
[h3]Storage[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333535/b6554e3e0d1353ff1edcd0255d8e0331e02b5527.png[/img]
[h3]Turn Around[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333535/33961cf181fecae3a86a3af949f485c89da9193d.png[/img]

[h2]Advance[/h2]
[h3]Scenic Route[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333535/d2755f20623eda5b51df8150b86d8613e03734f1.png[/img]

[h2]Expert[/h2]
[h3]Single Split[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333535/38a5b10e2a5ad0280b7b1361a1b144c2405fd0de.png[/img]


[h1]New Achievement![/h1]
[h2]Single Split Experiment[/h2]
[h3]To put simply, if you can solve Single Split, you will get this achievement![/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ErHTSfW.png[/img]


[h1]Last but not least... Russian language support![/h1]
[h2]Добро пожаловать, игроки![/h2]
[h3]The game is now fully translated into Russian![/h3] If you find any weird wordings or bugs with the UI, please let us know!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333535/3a2d3a3f2c5b58681fa6855db5daa903ab87ab5a.png[/img]


[h2]Minor patches and bug fixes[/h2]
- Level Restart button now works again
- Adjusted UI style and spacing to be more consistent and flexible for multi-lingual support
- New "Share" tab in level editor that allows you to more easily import/copy level data
- Indicator to restart the game when certain options that requires a restart is changed
- Improved popup visuals
- Steam depot is now split for Linux and Windows - Meaning smaller download size as only the files relevant for the version will be downloaded!
